title: How Serious Is Bird Flu Outbreak?
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: California officials have declared a state of emergency over the spread of bird flu.
sentences.zh: 加州官员宣布 禽流感蔓延为紧急状态

sentences.en: It is affecting milk cows in that state and causing illnesses in some people in other U.S. states.
sentences.zh: 它影响着美国的奶牛 并在其他美国州 的一些人中造成疾病

sentences.en: The avian influenza virus, or bird flu, has spread among wild birds, farm birds and many mammal species .
sentences.zh: 禽流感病毒(即禽流感)在野生鸟类、农禽和许多哺乳动物物种中蔓延。

sentences.en: The virus is known as Type A H5N1. It was identified for the first time in U.S. milk cows in March.
sentences.zh: 该病毒被称为A型H5N1病毒,是3月份首次在美国奶牛中发现的。

sentences.en: Since then, bird flu has been found in about one third of U.S. states.
sentences.zh: 从那时起,大约三分之一的美国州都发现了禽流感。

sentences.en: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is following the number of cases and is reporting the latest details on its website .
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制和预防中心(疾病控制和预防中心)正在跟踪病例数量,并在网站上报告最新详情。

sentences.en: Most of the illnesses have been mild. Health officials said that one person in Louisiana was hospitalized with the nation's first known severe illness caused by the virus.
sentences.zh: 大部分疾病是温和的。卫生官员说,在路易斯安那州,有一个人住院治疗了全国首例已知的由病毒引起的严重疾病。

sentences.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom said he declared the state of emergency so state workers could take faster action.
sentences.zh: 加州州长Gavin Newsom说,他宣布进入紧急状态,以便州政府工作人员能够采取更快的行动。

sentences.en: California officials have been testing milk tanks.
sentences.zh: 加州官员一直在测试牛奶罐

sentences.en: They said they have found the virus in hundreds of herds .
sentences.zh: 他们说他们在数百头牛群中发现了病毒

sentences.en: The virus was recently found in Southern California dairy farms.
sentences.zh: 病毒最近在南加州的乳制品农场被发现。

sentences.en: It was found in the state's Central Valley in August.
sentences.zh: 8月在州中央山谷发现

sentences.en: What is the risk to the general public? Officials with the CDC repeated that the public has a low risk of getting the virus.
sentences.zh: 公众面临的风险是什么? 疾病防治中心的官员重申,公众获得病毒的风险较低。

sentences.en: There are no reports of person-to-person infection and no signs that the virus has changed to spread easily among humans.
sentences.zh: 没有关于人与人之间感染的报告,也没有迹象表明病毒已经改变,容易在人之间传播。

sentences.en: Flu experts say it is too soon to know how the situation will change.
sentences.zh: 流感专家说,现在知道情况将如何改变还为时过早。

sentences.en: But some experts are worried because flu viruses are mutating all the time and small genetic changes could take place.
sentences.zh: 但有些专家担心 流感病毒会随时突变 基因会发生小的改变

sentences.en: Are cases becoming more serious? Health officials said the first known case of severe illness in the U.S. was found in a patient in Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 病例是否变得更加严重? 卫生官员说,在美国首例已知的严重疾病病例是在路易斯安那州的一个病人身上发现的。

sentences.en: The person is older than 65 and has other medical problems.
sentences.zh: 此人年龄超过65岁,并有其他医疗问题。

sentences.en: Officials said the person showed severe breathing problems after being near a group of sick birds.
sentences.zh: 官方说,此人在接近一群生病的鸟类后呼吸困难严重。

sentences.en: The CDC said that the Louisiana case is the first confirmed U.S. infection connected with backyard birds, or birds kept near a home.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心说,路易斯安那病是第一个确诊的美国感染 与后院鸟类有关, 或鸟留在家附近。

sentences.en: Almost all the earlier infections in the U.S. have been in farmworkers dealing with infected dairy cattle or birds.
sentences.zh: 在美国,几乎所有早期的感染者都是从事受感染奶牛或鸟类工作的农业工人。

sentences.en: In two cases — an adult in Missouri and a child in California — health officials have not learned how they became infected.
sentences.zh: 在两个案例中——密苏里的一个成年人和加利福尼亚的一个儿童——保健官员不知道他们是如何感染的。

sentences.en: Angela Rasmussen is a virus expert at the University of Saskatchewan in Canada.
sentences.zh: Angela Rasmussen是加拿大萨斯喀彻温大学的病毒专家。

sentences.en: She said as more people become infected, more severe illnesses will be reported.
sentences.zh: 她说,随着更多的人受到感染,将报告更严重的疾病。

sentences.en: Rasmussen said, "I assume that every H5N1 virus has the potential to be very severe and deadly."
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森说,“我假设每一种H5N1病毒 都有可能非常严重和致命。”

sentences.en: The World Health Organization says on its website that from 2003 to November 2024 about 142 people died from the H5N1 virus around the world.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织在其网站上说,从2003年到2024年11月,全世界约有142人死于H5N1病毒。

sentences.en: Most of the deaths were in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 多数死亡发生在东南亚。

sentences.en: How can people protect themselves? People who have contact with dairy cows, commercial poultry or with backyard birds are at higher risk than other people.
sentences.zh: 人们如何保护自己?与奶牛、商业家禽或后院鸟类接触的人比其他人面临更大的风险。

sentences.en: CDC and other experts said those people should use breathing, eye, and hand protection, especially if the animals appear ill or if they die.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心和其他专家说,这些人应该使用呼吸、眼睛和手力保护,特别是当动物生病或死亡时。

sentences.en: The CDC said in July that it would buy $5 million in vaccines for farmworkers to protect against seasonal flu.
sentences.zh: 疾病防治中心7月说,它将为农业工人购买500万美元的疫苗,以防止季节性流感。

sentences.en: If someone becomes infected with two flu types at the same time, it might permit the bird flu virus to mutate and to become more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 如果有人同时感染两种流感,可能会允许禽流感病毒变异,变得更加危险。

sentences.en: How else is bird flu spread? The H5N1 virus can also be spread in raw, or unpasteurized , milk.
sentences.zh: 禽流感是如何传播的?H5N1病毒也可以在生奶或未排污的牛奶中传播。

sentences.en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration says pasteurized milk is safe to drink because the heat treatment kills the virus.
sentences.zh: 美国食品和药品管理局说, 消毒牛奶是安全的饮料 因为热处理 杀死病毒。

sentences.en: But high levels of the virus have been found in unpasteurized milk.
sentences.zh: 但高浓度的病毒 已经发现在未经洗涤的牛奶。

sentences.en: Health officials urge people to avoid drinking raw milk.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员敦促人们不要喝生奶。

sentences.en: It can spread other germs in addition to bird flu.
sentences.zh: 除了禽流感,它还能传播其他细菌。

sentences.en: The U.S. Agriculture Department has increased its testing of raw milk across the country to identify and contain avian flu.
sentences.zh: 美国农业部增加了对全国生奶的检测,以查明并控制禽流感。

sentences.en: Federal officials ordered milk testing which began this month in 13 states.
sentences.zh: 本月在13个州开始,联邦官员下令进行牛奶测试。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Jonel Aleccia reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Mateo, Jonel Aleccia 向美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.
sentences.zh: 吉尔・罗宾斯改编了它 学习英语。
